name: Spinner
blurb: A rotating indicator for waits with no known end.
mechanism: An SVG arc and one `rotate` keyframe. Inside a button it is shown by a class on that button, so the spinner itself holds no state and needs no script.
caveats: A spinner says "something is happening" and nothing else. Pair it with text for anything over a second or two.
It is decorative: aria-hidden on the SVG, and put the words in a live region if the wait needs announcing.
Motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion; the arc stays, static.
